title: UNILAG Map
description: Built an interactive University of Lagos map using React and Canvas. Applied Dijkstra's algorithm for optimal pathfinding, providing a foundation for motion planning and coordination logic in autonomous systems.

title: Project Management System
description: Developed a system using Next.js and Express.js with Redis caching for faster project loading and drag-and-drop organization.

title: NodeJS Database Backup Utility
description: Created a CLI tool to back up PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases, simplifying database maintenance and recovery workflows.

title: ROS Navigation & Sensor Integration
description: Configured Ubuntu/ROS and deployed TurtleBot3 in Gazebo simulation, implementing autonomous environment detection and movement behaviors with sensors and LCD output on Arduino/ESP32.

title: HTTP Server from Scratch
description: Built a fully functional HTTP server in Go from the ground up, implementing TCP connection handling, request parsing, and response formatting without external frameworks.
